concours.name: La tente du Concours
concours.alt: The contest tent, painted in ink and gouache like a little theatre: blue-and-red striped canvas and a carved wooden frame with heavy curtains. Through the middle opening a prize-giving is under way on a three-tier stage: two identical framed pictures of the same grumpy cat, a bumblebee with a rosette looping the loop, a crow balancing on a tower of melons, a girl lifting an enormous pear, a grinning pumpkin beside a gold trophy, a goose wearing a huge rosette, a judge tying a blue rosette on a giant cabbage, a judge recoiling from a cake sunk into a crater, a little goblin holding up a wobbly green cake, a grandma giving a thumbs-up beside a perfect pink cake, a judge holding up ten fingers beside an ice-cream parfait, mice watching a black-and-white monster film, a grandad pouring lemonade for nervous children, and twins in matching band costumes beating matching drums. On the left the tent flap opens onto the park and a plank door shows a jam jar; on the right a door with a carrot and a door with a pink cake, and a ladder up to a balcony with blue, yellow, red and green doors.

confitures.name: Les confitures
confitures.alt: The jam tent, painted in ink and gouache in cool morning light: blue-and-red striped canvas and straw, seen from high up along one very long tasting table. A peacock sits in a toy van admiring his portrait, a tiny ant hauls a medal up a jar, a serious owl peers down from a jam jar, a pony shakes its head at a rabbit holding up a ticket, a two-tier jam cake stands on its plate, a hedgehog studies a diamond through a magnifying glass beside a carrot, a mouse drips under a teal umbrella full of holes, a toy pier sinks into a washtub, a small tomato sits shyly by a giant one, a cat naps in her own little roped corner with her rosette, a badger peers at a stingray in a glass tank, a girl holds up a teal pocket knife, a mouse drops a wilted lettuce into a crate, a puppy sits innocently beside a chewed slipper, and two pigs shake on a deal over a fine marrow. A jam pan steams on a stove by the plank door on the left, a wasp circles a jar and a pig licks spilt jam on the straw.

potager.name: Le potager
potager.alt: The vegetable show, painted in ink and gouache in warm late-afternoon light, seen at eye level through the blue-and-red striped tent canvas, with the back rolled up onto real vegetable beds and bunting. A tall wooden show stand rises in the middle: an owl on top gives a thumbs-up, a gold trophy stands beside the tiniest pumpkin, two mice share one red apple, a cake carries one sunflower seed, and a beaver judge sorts entry tags in a whirl. An old dean in cap and gown holds a rosette with dignity, three judges peer at a giant marrow through magnifying glasses, a smiling knight rides a gnu past waving onlookers, a carrot grown into the shape of a rabbit sits beside a real rabbit with its nose in the air, and a grandma pins a rosette on a boy carrying pies. On the left is the plank door with a painted carrot; on the right a prize table with glass cloches and rosettes.

gateaux.name: Les gâteaux
gateaux.alt: The cake tent at dusk, painted in ink and gouache: cool blue evening light through the blue-and-red striped canvas and a glowing lantern by the plank door, looking straight down a long judging table to the open far end. A girl on a stepladder waters a sunflower that has grown up through the roof, and a giraffe pokes its head in through another hole. At the far end a seagull sings opera while two judges cheer; an elephant gazes at a party cake bristling with candles; a grumpy pony judge frowns at a row of cupcakes; a judge peers through a huge magnifying glass; a goat runs off with a purple rosette while its judge clutches his cheeks; a judge winces at his green soup as a little dog backs away; a boy behind a toppling stack of cake tins holds up five fingers; and a little table bows under one enormous pumpkin. A tall blue dresser of cakes under glass domes stands on the right.

jury.name: La loge du jury
jury.alt: The jury booth seen from high above at bright midday, painted in ink and gouache: a round pen of blue-and-red striped canvas with a blue wooden door, standing on a straw-strewn plank floor with hay bales and a coil of rope outside. In the middle of a round blue rug a giant marrow statue on a plinth blocks three bewigged judges who can't get round it. A mockingbird on a stool flaps and laughs; a judge dozes in a red armchair dreaming of a perfect beach; another taps the crust of a crème brûlée; a small whale in a tub stares sadly at a tiny slice of cake; a hedgehog judge in a wig shrugs at a lumpy green dish; a duck settles into her washtub; a piglet is delighted by a cake made of mud; a judge holds up a mouldy pie as flies buzz round it; a prize waistcoat on a dummy hangs its buttons on thin threads; and a snail follows a wooden signpost.

doors.label: La tente du Concours

rates.name: Les ratés
rates.alt: The disaster corner on a rainy afternoon, painted in ink and gouache: cool grey-green light, a wet plank floor and red-and-blue striped canvas walls, with a yellow plank door and an umbrella stand on the left and a mop bucket by the tent pole on the right. In the middle stands a rickety two-storey wooden booth under a striped awning. On top, a champion pumpkin's little red cape flies off in the breeze while a judge on the ladder pins a rosette on a gigantic marrow, and a marrow carved into a little dragon wears its special ribbon. A tiered cake slides sideways as its tiny chef topper dives for safety, above a soufflé sagging in its dish. A pot of green soup steams with stink and a fly holds its nose; a judge sneezes a dandelion clean off the table; a can of beans explodes over a bearded judge; a lady in a flowered hat shakes a pebble out of her fancy shoe; a jack-in-the-box bursts out in streamers and a kitten leaps back; a mouse points at the seventh spot on a big ladybird; and an octopus in a washtub waves his eighth arm high.

doors.label: La tente du Concours
doors.hint: Go back through the yellow door to the main tent

espoirs.name: Les espoirs
espoirs.alt: The junior contest on a bright spring morning, painted in ink and gouache: sunbeams and paper bunting inside the red-and-blue striped tent, a red plank door on the left and a rolled-up tent flap on the right opening onto a green meadow, with a watering can on the floor. In the middle stands a round three-tier wooden stand like a little carousel. At the top three children crowd round a sweet table of cakes and lollipops, wishing to stay; a carrot sculpture made to look like the judge, nose and all, stands beside the startled old judge; a lady judge tastes a spoon of jam, pauses and smiles; and a very old tortoise judge in spectacles tastes jam from a jar. A prawn clings to a storybook it can't put down, and a mouse beside a wedge of cheese raises a paw to ask a question. On the middle tier a steady tortoise plods past an open storybook, a tiny seedling sprouts in its pot, and snails creep along their own lane marked with little flags. Below, a teddy bear snoozes under a patchwork quilt among mended toys, and a tin robot peels a whole mountain of potatoes.

sante.name: La santé
sante.alt: The first-aid tent at dawn, painted in ink and gouache: soft pink-gold light through the open flap, white-and-green striped canvas, a green plank door, a first-aid chest with a green cross, shelves of rolled bandages, piles of folded blankets and big jugs. One little rain cloud rains only on a pot of prize roses. A horse shakes his head at a greasy burger held out to an old man resting on a camp bed, whose very worn shoe has a flapping sole and peeking toes. Through the flap a little green vegetable van is parked right by the doorway, and a happy dog trots back in, lead trailing. A goat leaps off past a wobbly chair, a judge coughs at the black smoke rising from a burnt pie, and a cautious hedgehog holds up a tiny umbrella under the clear sky. A proud lion sulks in a headband of bunny ears; a dog hides under a lily-patterned seat cushion with sausages peeking out; a quaint painted wooden yo-yo lies beside a pocket watch on a stool; and a small grass snake naps under a straw sun hat.

potager_casier.name: La vitrine des prix
potager_casier.alt: A close-up at the vegetable show's prize table, in the same warm late-afternoon light and blue-and-red striped canvas, with leeks and cabbages showing through the drapes and wicker baskets stacked on the right. A crowd presses round a small round table: a judge bites a pie and rings his brass bell at once, a sweating judge gulps a tall glass of water beside a dish of red chillies, an old lady hands a young woman in a straw hat a brown paper parcel and a small slip, a kind old judge pats the shoulder of a nervous little girl clutching her first jam jar, a tiered white cake carries two sugar swans, and a green parrot bows low to the giant prize marrow.

gateaux_casier.name: Le buffet des gâteaux
gateaux_casier.alt: A close-up of the blue cake dresser in the cake tent at dusk, in the same cool blue light and warm lantern glow between blue-and-red striped canvas. Cakes sit under glass domes on its shelves while the buffet is raided: two sweating judges fan themselves with giant fern leaves, a hen in a red bow tie pecks one crumb from the prize pie, a little girl in a party hat holds the limp string of her popped balloon, a mouse tiptoes up beside a wobbling tower of marmalade jars on a stool, a tabby cat creeps under the table towards a dropped blob of cream, and a toy delivery van has crashed under the table, its honey pots oozing all over the floor.
